name: A Blade Called Hope
description: A thin, curved sword that glows with faint light, visible only in total darkness. When bathed in heavy sunlight, its first attack is Enhanced.

name: A Treatise on the Abyss
description: A nondescript black book. An in-depth, largely theoretical text describing the Roots, as well as information about the location of a nearby Gate.

name: Alchemical Limb
description: Replaces a limb torn off by a mock firefly. Immune to heat and poison. Needs to be oiled daily.

name: Alchemical Tattoo
description: A dog, cat, or bird that can leave your body on demand. It follows your commands to the best of its abilities and can pass its injuries (as STR loss) back onto you.

name: Amadou
description: A vermilion fungus that catches fire quite easily.

name: Aqua Vita
description: Purifies any liquid, converting it to pure water. Drinking it cures 1d6 STR.

name: Assassin's Goblets
description: A pair of fragile wine flutes. Any liquid poured into one is swapped with the other.

name: Babbleflask
description: A foreign language is automatically understood and can be spoken back with fluency, so long as the drinker's native tongue is neither spoken nor heard.

name: Barbed Epaulets
description: Spiked shoulder pads that poison anyone that touches them (STR save or lose consciousness).

name: Beauty Cream
description: Apply to appear irresistibly beautiful for the next 12 hours.

name: Betterwand
recharge: Willingly accept a poor deal or trade while in possession of the wand.
description: Vibrates with increased intensity when pointed at the best of a series of objects.

name: Bezoar Stone
description: Ingesting it cures any poison.

name: Black Rose Fiddle
description: Its music causes intense sadness and immobility in nearby mortals. (Others are merely fascinated.) You don't know how to play it.

name: Black Tar
description: Versatile: both sticky and highly flammable.

name: Blacked-Out Ledger
description: Taken when you swore to always repay your debts, whether in coin or in kind.

name: Blacklegged Dandy
description: Hardy and adaptable. Tough or Perilous terrain are one step easier. 6 HP.

name: Blast Sphere
description: A head-sized iron ball filled with explosive powder that detonates on impact.

name: Blinding Powder
description: Taken from a guild warehouse job.

name: Blood Pail
recharge: Fill with the blood of a dying warrior.
description: From a local death-cult. Empty it to raise a servant built from whatever is buried below, with 6 HP, 1 Armor, 13 STR, 11 DEX, 4 WIL, and shard fists (1d8+1d8). Only one servant can be raised at a time. If destroyed, you permanently lose 1d4 STR.

name: Bloodmap
recharge: Pour a pint of your own life essence onto the map, blood for blood. You are deprived until you can rest and eat a Ration.
description: A blank leather parchment that absorbs any blood spilled on its surface before rolling into a tight scroll. Unroll to see a rough map revealing the current location of any remaining blood. The image disappears after a few minutes.

name: Bloodvine Whip
description: On Critical Damage, it drains the target's blood, granting the weapon's next attack the blast quality.

name: Blunderbuss
description: A prototype firearm that takes one round to reload.

name: Bone Knife
description: Blood-stained, taken after nearly being killed by an antlered demon. On Critical Damage, its next attack becomes enhanced from contact with blood.

name: Book on Astronomy
description: Your debut composition's notes resembled stellar constellations, drawing you into questions of the sky.

name: Breeze Knot
recharge: Tie it to a mast during a storm.
description: Creates a strong breeze.

name: Briar Thorn
description: Can pierce any organic material (quite painfully) but leaves no trace when removed.

name: Briarvine
description: Entangles any creature up to horse size (STR to break free). Reusable.

name: Burial Wagon
description: A wagon from your last job as a Bonekeeper. Came with a stubborn old donkey (+4 slots, only +2 slots if pulling the wagon).

name: Captain's Uniform
description: Taken after your latest stunt destroyed a priceless artifact and injured a dozen bystanders.

name: Carrion Cat
description: A clever pet, small enough to hide in your pack, but strong enough to scare off smaller predators. Requires one ration a day, and it must be meat.

name: Catring
recharge: Place the ring on a stray cat's tail.
description: Climb up walls and fall safely.

name: Celestial Lute
description: Reveals the constellations above, no matter the weather.

name: Ceremonial Sword
description: Harmless, deals no damage.

name: Cipher Stone
description: A pair of sharp black stones. Each one decrypts any message written by the other.

name: Clatter Keeper
description: A hand-cranked device that emits a loud noise, frightening away most creatures.

name: Coin of the Father
recharge: Carry the coin for three days without spending or earning any money.
description: Flip this worthless-looking hunk of flat metal in the air, and it will transform into 1d100 gold coins. The illusory coins disappear after one hour.

name: Crow-Shaped Amulet
description: You can ask a question of the dead but must add a Fatigue each time. They do not always speak truthfully.

name: Crowbar
description: Sometimes you just need to get the damn thing open!

name: Cursed Sapphire
description: It noticeably returns to your pocket shortly after you spend it. You can't seem to get rid of it.

name: Cusped Falchion
description: Taken from crop thieves who outnumbered you.

name: Cutpurse's Ladder
description: A 10ft folding ladder, taken from a guild warehouse job.

name: Death-Whistle
recharge: Capture the final breath of a dying warrior.
description: Its scream frightens away all who hear it (WIL save or flee).

name: Delphinium
description: Breathe water for up to one hour. Can be divided into fractional doses.

name: Diseased Crop
description: A relic of the Withering, a type of stem rot from the Roots. Quickly decays any plant it touches.

name: Dream Stone
description: A smooth blue stone that helps recall dreams more clearly. Overuse can cause dream-addiction.

name: Drowning Rod
description: A finger-sized wooden stick that doubles in size each time it is fully submerged in water. It does not shrink down again.

name: Drowse Balm
description: A wax bar. If boiled in water, the steam acts as a soporific agent.

name: Dryad's Tear
description: Shatter this crystal to merge with a tree you can touch. You can perceive the goings-on within whatever forest that tree belongs to.

name: Echo Leaf
description: A blank parchment. Whomever unfurls it sees their actions of the day slowly revealed in a tight scrawl.

name: Empathy Rod
recharge: Give the rod to a former enemy as a gift. This is a one-way transaction.
description: When two creatures touch this wooden pole at the same time, their physical and emotional states become fully intertwined until they let go.

name: Everbloom Band
description: A circlet adorned with flowers that never wilt. On Critical Damage, the flowers dissolve into dust, but you act as if your save succeeded (STR loss still occurs).

name: Everquill
description: A quill that writes on any surface. You still need ink.

name: Eyestone
recharge: Place in a bucket of rainwater overnight.
description: Choose an object created by living creatures. You can sense the nearest example.

name: Falconstone
recharge: Kill and eat a common quarry, cooking the meat alongside the stone.
description: Perceive the world through the eyes and ears of a nearby bird of prey. You feel whatever it feels but have no control over it.

name: False Cuffs
description: Comfortable, realistic-looking cuffs. Only you know the trick to get out of them.

name: Fence Cutters
description: Taken from a noble's summer home, which was full of fancy wine but not much else.

name: Fermented Spirits
description: Keeps you warm at the best of times and as an explosive at the worst.

name: Fib Ink
description: Glows when used to write true statements but fades if used to write false ones.

name: Fieldwarden's Fireseeds
description: A pouch gathered after a crop spirit's fires consumed nearly everything.

name: Fire Eggs
description: Six small pellets made of sea salt, wood, and crockery-dust. They explode at low heat, but the flames dissipate quickly.

name: Fireflask
description: Highly alcoholic, yet strangely delicious. When thrown, it creates a wall of flames 10ft high that burns out after a few minutes.

name: Fireworks
description: A dazzling, albeit dangerous, display. Enough explosive material to blow off a finger or three.

name: Footpad's Friend
description: Soft leather shoes that adapt to fit any foot size. Leave behind footprints that scatter and turn in a confusing manner, making tracking nigh-impossible.

name: Foundling's Storybook
description: Left behind by a troupe of traveling entertainers who vanished overnight.

name: Gale Seed Extract
description: Ingesting it lets you sprint with a speed four times your regular rate. Afterward, add two Fatigue.

name: Garden of Glass
description: Bound in the cover of another book. A heretical work describing the materials, procedures, and optimal locations required to open a Gate.

name: Gate Chalk
description: Draw a doorway on any flat surface to open a one-way passage to the Roots. Good luck.

name: Ghost Violin
description: A dark-gray violin that plays a haunting tune, mirrored by an invisible, distant twin.

name: Gildfinger
recharge: Bundle it with at least 100gp for a night.
description: A finger glove that mimics any mundane key.

name: Glamour Feather
description: Plume of a firebird. Can make any creature appear convincingly as someone (or something) else.

name: Glimpse Glass
description: A monocle that lets you see through walls or other obstructions. It shatters after the last use.

name: Glowsnail
description: Casts a soft, bioluminescent light. Feeds on one ration every two days.

name: Gnarled Staff
description: All you took when you left the druid who taught you the language of trees.

name: Goat Powder
description: Derived from the placenta of a baby goat. Temporarily cures any affliction, but symptoms return within hours.

name: Gold Powder
description: Fake gold dust, nearly indistinguishable from the real thing.

name: Golden Wheat Paste
description: When mixed with water, this substance chemically bonds any two objects.

name: Goosefelt Tarp
description: Fits two. Stolen before leaving home when you joined to escape family trouble.

name: Gossip Box
recharge: Successfully spread one falsehood in the presence of the box.
description: Wind the crank to replay any sound made in the past day in your current location. Each crank goes back one hour.

name: Graftgrub
description: A small worm that can fuse inanimate objects with parts of the body.

name: Greenwhistle
description: A small flute that calms plants, making passage through areas heavy with plant life a bit easier.

name: Greenwise's Healing Potion
description: Completely restores STR. Only you know of its unintended side effects.

name: Harbinger's Bell
recharge: Melt and reforge. Each time, roll a 1d6. On a 1-2, it breaks forever.
description: Hang at chest height to ring when danger is imminent.

name: Hardening Glue
description: Makes any flat material (cloth, leather, sand) as hard as stone.

name: Hawthorn Seed
description: An acorn from the other side, gathered on the spring equinox. When planted, it sprouts a luxurious shelter, collapsing at moonrise the next day.

name: Healing Unguent
description: Taught by a wizened apothecary. Restores 1d4 STR.

name: Heartseed
description: Saved from the roots of a dying tree, poisoned by a malicious forest spirit. Plant it to create a new forest.

name: Heavy Destrier
description: A beast built for war, an imposing creature. 8 HP, hooves (1d10+1d10).

name: Hellcap
description: Exposure to its aroma causes intense nausea and vomiting. Either way, it clears the room. Bottled.

name: Hex Stone
description: Gathered from a river that flows from the other side. Removed from its iron tin, it can absorb the effects of an active magical effect. If destroyed, the magic is released.

name: Homunculus
description: A miniature clay replica of yourself that follows your every command. It hates being enthralled to you and complains bitterly whenever possible. Any damage done to the homunculus is also done to you. 3 HP, 4 STR, 13 DEX, 5 WIL.

name: Homunculus Nail
description: Prick a finger with the pointy end and hammer into any small object to form a loyal servant [3 HP, 4 STR, 13 DEX, 5 WIL] completely devoted to you. If not destroyed, it will outlive you.

name: Honest Earworm
description: A foul-smelling, pinky-sized worm that feeds on earwax by crawling into the ear canal of a sleeping person. The victim then loses the ability to lie for 1d4 hours.

name: Impressive Pin
description: A metal badge of honor from the Guard. It can open doors but leaves a trail.

name: Incense
description: Perfect for rituals or to keep the flies at bay. Cools the blood.

name: Iron Bracers
description: Taken after saving a heartseed from a malicious forest spirit's victim.

name: Iron Rattle
description: A noisemaker for distracting or scaring your quarry. Sounds convincingly like a snake.

name: Ivy Worm
description: A green worm often mistaken for a weed. Swallowed whole, it absorbs any toxins or rot in the body before exiting through the usual way.

name: Jar of Ants
description: Break to release a colony of fire ants [6 HP, 2 STR, 10 DEX, 1 WIL, bite (1d10), detachment]. Consumes a ration every two days.

name: Jongleur's Rapier
description: Light-weight. Taken after an actor died and you were blamed, despite your training in the deadly arts.

name: Kettlewright's Necklace
description: Sold to monasteries and nobles alike.

name: Kettlewright's Saw
description: Taken while scavenging raw tin and iron from battlefields.

name: Key to a Safehouse
description: Taken when the Oath was simply a means of avoiding punishment as a convict.

name: Last Breath
recharge: Deliver a killing blow with the sword, absorbing the dying victim's soul into the blade. There is a cunning intelligence within that speaks to the wielder, forever asking for more souls, more!
description: A chipped short sword of dubious quality. Drive into the earth to form a crystal dome that encircles and immobilizes the wielder. The dome is impenetrable by mundane means, and shatters once the sword is lifted again.

name: Lightsucker Candle
description: Once lit, this black tallow wax sheds darkness rather than light, even in the brightest of days.

name: Linden White
description: Highly trained and agile; performs intricate maneuvers in a time of need (no DEX save to flee). 4 HP.

name: Lodestone
description: Draws out dangerous elements from the body and acts as a powerful magnetic force.

name: Lover's Covenant
description: A bottle of red-tinted ink, a broken heart emblazoned on the front. Write up a contract of any length. Any who sign are bound to obey by penalty of death.

name: Luxcompass
description: Hums softly as it moves closer to the Sun. Eventually the noise becomes unbearably loud.

name: Mace of the Kingslayer
recharge: Deliver a fatal blow to the leader of a group or faction.
description: Hold the weapon aloft and shout an order or declaration. Any who fail a WIL save must obey, against their better judgment.

name: Manacles
description: Though old, they're still effective even against the very strong. You don't have the key.

name: Mapping Paper
description: Taken during a dark period in your life, when you needed direction.

name: Marchguard's Throwing Knives
description: A brace of knives, taken when your family lost everything.

name: Metal Ingot
description: A heavy ingot of fake gold, made in your workshop.

name: Milkflower
description: A gentle stimulant. Chewing it makes you immune to panic for the next hour.

name: Mimic Stone
description: Records a short phrase that can later be played back.

name: Miner's Grease
description: Great for dislodging a gem, tool, or limb from a tight crack. Highly explosive.

name: Miracle Oil
description: A smelly, slippery concoction.

name: Monk's Habit
description: Warm. Taken when you snuck away from a secluded forest monastery.

name: Moth Mirror
description: A full-length, double-sided glass mirror. Step into the mirror to be transported to another mirror you know. You come out of the other side as an enormous swarm of buzzing moths, striking those around you with paralysis (WIL save to avoid) as they gaze upon you in horror. You can revert to your normal form at will. The mirror only operates in one direction.

name: Muffle Dust
description: A pouch of fine dust that muffles all sound in a 40ft radius when scattered.

name: Murderous Truffle
description: Pungent, highly toxic, and very rare (worth 50gp to assassins). Illegal pretty much everywhere.

name: Mythos Mask
description: A plaster mask that allows one to take on a monster's countenance. Once it comes off, add a Fatigue.

name: Nightdust Powder
description: Made from the ritual burning of six owls. When tossed in the air, day turns to night for a short while.

name: Nightstone
description: Rare moon-shaped stones dredged from underwater caves and jungle dolines. Swallow whole to relieve all fatigue and deprivation as if you had a good night's sleep and a good meal. The stone will eventually pass through your system. It isn't fun.

name: Oath Compass
description: Points not towards North, but instead to the nearest member of the Guard. It also lets you know when they're getting close.

name: Obliteration Scroll
description: A single-page document filled with gibberish. Sign anywhere on the page to remove any knowledge of your existence from this plane of reality. No one will know or remember you, and any references to your name or lineage will vanish. The scroll disappears in a puff of smoke that smells faintly of sulfur.

name: Oft-mended Chain Mail
description: Well-worn armor from the forge where you grew up.

name: Oilskin Coat
description: Taken during a dark period in your life, when you needed direction.

name: Pain Band
recharge: Wear the ring while in perfect health. You will lose 1 STR, permanently.
description: Touch an injured creature to transfer their wounds to you. (Exchange their lost STR with your own.)

name: Pan Flute
description: Emits a high-pitched sound that only rodents can hear. So long as you play, they will follow, even to their deaths.

name: Paring Knife
description: Taken after hunting an azure warbler, whose gametes attract a sizeable profit if properly extracted.

name: Parliament's Promise
description: A helmet in the form of an owl's head. Its wearer can twist their head around like an owl and can see in darkness with perfect clarity. While wearing the helm, the wearer loses the ability to speak, uttering only the simplest of cooing noises.

name: Phoenix Ash
description: Sprinkle over a corpse to resurrect the deceased. They return with full health but no memory of their past life.

name: Piebald Cob
description: Intelligent; understands simple commands and has an instinct for danger. 6 HP.

name: Pipeweed
description: Your good luck charm. Conversations tend to flow more easily after a smoke.

name: Plague Doctor's Mask
description: Taken after its owner succumbed to the disease that wiped out everyone you once knew.

name: Pneuma Pump
description: Portable iron lungs. Enables life-saving surgery or underwater breathing.

name: Poacher's Woe
description: Strongly-scented arrows. The scent is powerful enough to track with ease.

name: Pocket Leyfinder
description: Points to nearby ley lines and other sources of arcane power. If you lose it, the punishment is death.

name: Pocket Theatre
description: A set of small puppets and a folding stage. Good for quick distractions.

name: Private Room & Board
description: Fits 4.

name: Pulley
description: Great for moving gravestones, rocks, or even bodies.

name: Pullstones
description: Two jet-black stones. When separated, the stones will always roll toward one another.

name: Pyrophoric Gel
description: A sticky green fluid that catches fire when exposed to air, then burns for 8 hours. Cannot be extinguished.

name: Quell Stone
description: Wrapped in burlap. Extinguishes any nearby flames once exposed to air.

name: Quick-Flame Rod
description: Taken by an Arachnid specialist. Can destroy a large spider nest in seconds.

name: Quicksilver
description: A stimulant. Go first in combat, and automatically pass any WIL saves for one hour. Addictive: save STR or become deprived after 24 hours without it.

name: Quicksilver Chain
description: Without it, you are unable to shift back from wolf form.

name: Rabbit Skull
description: Protects against charms.

name: Rabbit's Foot
description: You were wearing it when they found you. They say it is the foot of she who left you, and that it protects you from witch magic.

name: Raven Familiar
description: 8 HP, 3 STR, 11 DEX, 13 WIL, beak (1d6). Speaks as an intelligent being and is entirely devoted to you.

name: Rebirth Ash
description: Remnants of a bark spirit. Sprinkle to reignite a fire that has died or return to life a creature that has died only moments before.

name: Rebreak Glass
description: A wine flute that can be broken multiple times, reforming after 24 hours. Makes a really loud noise.

name: Reed Whistle
description: Anyone in earshot must pass a WIL save to perform an act of violence.

name: Regrowth Salve
description: Regrows a body part over the course of a day.

name: Reinforced Spiked Boots
description: Cracks heads as easily as it does ice and muck. Travel is also a bit slower, but easier.

name: Retractable Wires
description: Taken after a botched bank job. You bear a brand only visible by firelight; anyone who sees the mark can ask you for a beer.

name: Reverse Teetotum
description: When spun, time skips backwards 30 seconds. Everyone remembers what happened.

name: Rill Runner's Feather Quill
description: A map drawn with this quill reveals the most expedient course between any two points.

name: Rime Seed
description: Freezes any body of water, no matter the size. Don't eat it.

name: Ring of the Snake
recharge: Bury the ring with a corpse. A month later, exhume the corpse and retrieve it.
description: A wrought-iron serpent ring. Place it on your finger and fall into a sleep so deep that most will think you are dead. If the ring is removed, you will awaken feeling refreshed. Otherwise, the effect will wear off after one month.

name: River Twine
description: A spool of twine. Each dip into the river guarantees a catch, though it might not be pleasant.

name: Rivertooth
description: Impressively strong, capable of carrying heavy loads. 4 HP. Only +2 slots if carrying two people.

name: Roc Feather
description: Hold while falling to float safely to the ground from any height.

name: Room & Board
description: Per night.

name: Root Tether
description: When thrown, binds a creature as large as a wolf to the soil for a short time.

name: Rootflower
description: A white fungus found only on corpses deep underground. Ingest to restore 1d6 WIL. You will dream of the dead and their stories.

name: Royal Crest
description: Born into royalty, you chose a different life. The crest grants you access but also alerts your family of your whereabouts.

name: Sanguine Lens
description: Extracts blood from a target without their knowledge. A stolen drop placed on the eye reveals memories from the past day.

name: Scroll of Mirrorwalk
description: A single-use scroll bearing an unusual, little-known spell.

name: Seed Bomb
description: A canvas sack filled with seeds that explode on impact.

name: Sessile Oak Bow
description: Slams into targets. On Critical Damage, something is torn off.

name: Shrieking Trumpet
description: When exposed to light, it screams so loudly that all nearby attacks (including your own) are impaired.

name: Silk Moth Shawl
description: A weatherproof blanket; it can also douse a fire without being damaged.

name: Silver Marsh Crawler's Tooth
description: Worn on a chain around your neck. Hums softly when something is stalking you.

name: Sketchbook
description: Filled with detailed drawings.

name: Skull Whistle
recharge: Feed the instrument a clump of human hair pulled from a living skull.
description: Produces a chilling scream that forces any who hear it (including the blower) to make a WIL save or become temporarily incapacitated.

name: Sloth-Tarp
description: A tough and weatherproof fabric, useful for hanging off trees. When inside, you have +1 Armor.

name: Smelting Hammer
description: Taken from your days as a military smelter.

name: Smith's Apron
description: From a gruff blacksmith who raised you.

name: Smoke Pellets
description: Taken after a university job you were seen at, but not pursued.

name: Snare Trap
description: Taken after your life was saved by a member of the Marchguard.

name: Soporific Concoction
description: Taken after a close friend disappeared into the Wood.

name: Soul Clump
description: A hard, fist-sized ball covered in small bumps. When rolled on a flat surface, it collects any objects smaller than its current mass, which subsequently increases as more items are attached to its surface. Only living creatures are immune.

name: Spark Dust
description: Ignites easily and quickly. Useful for starting a fire or as an incendiary device.

name: Spike and Cord
description: For traversing difficult terrain or for creating makeshift traps and structures.

name: Sponge
description: Supposedly made from the remains of a rare sea creature. It never seems to dry out.

name: Sponge Army
description: A dozen miniature soldiers made of carved sea sponges. When splashed with water, they grow to full size [8 HP, 6 STR, 13 DEX, 5 WIL, hardened sponge (1d6), detachment] and follow the orders of the person they see until they are destroyed or dry out completely (about 10 minutes).

name: Sproutcup
description: Ingest to shrink down to the size of a mouse. (Your belongings stay the same size.) You return to normal size within the hour, often in fits and starts.

name: Spystone
recharge: To record a new sound, skip the rock at least three times on a body of water and recover it.
description: A smooth, flat stone that is slightly warm to the touch. Squeeze to record audio in a 40ft radius. Squeeze again to play it back, as many times as you like.

name: Stable & Feed
description: Per night.

name: Stage Mail
description: Well-worn armor. Taken after you were scarred in an on-stage accident.

name: Star-Iron Mace
description: Shines faintly in darkness and becomes very hot in the presence of witchcraft.

name: Steadymade Buckler
description: While holding this shield, you cannot be moved so long as both feet are planted on firm ground.

name: Sticky Rope
recharge: Cut off 10ft of rope, which then withers away.
description: A 100ft rope that can stick to any surface.

name: Stink Jar
description: Shattering this jar releases an odor so foul all nearby must make a STR save or immediately vomit.

name: Stone Eater
description: A rodent-sized centipede that consumes and digests stone, capable of cutting a small tunnel in under an hour. It can be used more than once, but only if you can catch it (DEX 18).

name: Stone Flute
description: Can calm almost any river.

name: Stone Pine Bow
description: Produces one use of Sticky Sap per day. The sap is highly explosive.

name: Stonetree Sap
description: Sap obtained in exchange for blood. Hardens when rubbed on any surface.

name: Stonewax Gum
description: Chew, then spit. The gum will harden and stretch, making a perfect, unbreakable seal.

name: Stray Fogger
description: Wild but very fast (even in Tough terrain). Rides light. 4 HP.

name: Striped Bamboo Bow
description: Collapsible; it only requires one slot (but still requires both hands).

name: Strong Silk Rope
description: 30ft. Taken from a heist on a Constable's quarters, escaping but leaving some friends behind.

name: Sun Stick
recharge: Leave in heavy sunlight for a full day.
description: Provides ample warmth and light for up to one hour.

name: Surgeon's Soap
description: A lye and ash block that makes skin temporarily transparent, revealing the anatomy within.

name: Sweetwhistle
recharge: Lose a dear memory. (Describe it.)
description: Listeners hear a soft, familiar voice in the distance that they cannot resist following.

name: Tacky Stalk
description: A woody reed that hardens into a permanent adhesive when chewed.

name: Tally Stick
description: Once a vow is marked onto its face, the stick hardens. It will snap in half if the vow is ever broken.

name: Tent
description: Fits 2.

name: The Cathedral and the Canopy
description: Large-leaf binding over vellum. Nominally a children's storybook, the margins detail information about traveling, eating, and sleeping in the cloud forests.

name: The Silent Symphony
description: Bound in fluorescent wrap. Very rare; chronicles the subtle signs used by those employing invisibility magic.

name: The Star Waltz
description: A comet-shaped clasp bound in fine leather. Detailed astronomical charts, celestial movements, and stellar festivals.

name: The Wild Tongue
description: A bundle of leather-bound scrolls. A seminal work cataloging the hidden languages of beasts and how to understand them.

name: Thesaurus
description: Without it, you are deprived. Taken after you were cursed to speak only in rhyme.

name: Tin Helm
description: Taken from your days as a military smelter.

name: Tin of Snuff
description: Dampens your lost sense of smell, now able to sniff out gold as a pig does truffles. Use it every day or become deprived.

name: Tinker's Paste
description: Seals shut any fist-sized opening.

name: Torch Fungus
description: When crushed, it creates a cold blue light for a short while.

name: Tragic Tales
description: Banned in proper company, this book becomes less bawdy and more harrowing towards the end.

name: Trail Shaker
description: A noisy instrument that reveals nearby trails, even when deeply hidden.

name: Tupshead Crown
description: A beautifully rendered ram's head helm wrought from tough alpine oak. The horns can be used as weapons (1d6+1d6).

name: Uncanny Hand-Puppet
description: Taken after your puppeteering and mimicry skills got you branded a witch and banished.

name: Universal Solvent
description: Dissolves anything it touches into its constituent parts.

name: Unmarked Repellent
description: Powerful stuff. Its faded label makes it unclear what it is actually meant to repel, though. Perhaps everything.

name: Vagrant's Veil
recharge: Donate the day's winnings to the poor.
description: Wear it to blend seamlessly into crowds, appearing as a simple pauper.

name: Veilsilk Grip
recharge: Snip off one of the fingers.
description: A hand wearing this glove can phase through solid objects.

name: Voice of the Mountain
description: A rough pebble imbued with the essence of a mountain spirit. Crush to call forth an earthquake or similar natural disaster. Do not expect to be spared.

name: Voidglass Shard
description: Peer through it to see invisible marks, creatures, and other magical effects. Lose the use of your eye for an hour afterwards (deprived).

name: Warble-Whistle
recharge: Feed a baby bird as its mother would, then blow.
description: Can imitate any bird call and can even be used to send simple messages.

name: Ward Stone
description: A flat, unassuming river stone notched with faded symbols. Smash to release a silvery powder in a 20ft radius that pacifies anyone who breathes it.

name: Warming Stone
description: Generates an irresistible heat. Carried by a Serpent specialist.

name: Weathered Longbow
description: Taken from the old hunter who raised you.

name: Western Yew Bow
description: Can be wielded as a blunt weapon (1d6). Noisy.

name: Whisper Vial
description: Whisper a message into the vial, and it will play it back to whoever opens it next.

name: Whispergale
description: A balloon-shaped plant that captures a spoken message and delivers it to a location within a day's walk.

name: Whistle-Rope
description: 15ft of highly flexible leather. Swirl in the air to generate a powerful subsonic effect that drives away wildlife. Also works underwater.

name: White Ash Bow
description: Can be used in place of a shield in melee combat (+1 Armor).

name: Wisp Lantern
description: Caged in wrought iron, provides a dim light so long as the wisp is able to feed on nearby pain and fear.

name: Wolfsbane Wreath
description: Taken by a Canine specialist. Effective against werewolves as well as canines.

name: Wonder Bar
recharge: Hold the bar with both hands without letting go for one continuous hour (WIL save to succeed). You can make only one attempt each day.
description: Pressing the switch on the side of this iron bar freezes it in place, even in midair. Once frozen, it cannot be moved by any force until the switch is depressed.

name: Woundwax
description: Heals wounds from fire or chemicals (restoring full STR) but nothing else.

name: Wraith Lantern
recharge: Kill the last person found with the help of the lantern, trapping their spirit inside. The lantern must be nearby when they are killed.
description: Write someone's name onto its glass, and the name will disappear. The lantern reveals a path to their current location, visible only to the holder (day or night).

name: Wych Elm Bow
description: Protects the bearer from poisons and toxins, so long as they are holding it.

name: Wyrmbone Whetstone
description: Following a half-hour ritual sharpening, attacks with the weapon are enhanced until STR damage is dealt.
